description: An abstract class defining common behavior for message command response classes within the Eclipse Ditto project, including serialization, deserialization, equality, and string representation methods.

classes.name: AbstractMessageCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract base class for responses to message commands, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and identity.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this message response.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message payload associated with this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the message payload and related data to a JSON object builder, used during serialization.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Message object from JSON.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on super class, thingId, and message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this object and another, considering thingId and message.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Ensures correct behavior in inheritance hierarchies for equality.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including thingId and message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to set Ditto headers, to be implemented by subclasses.
